title: Resolve nav tab labels via stringResource in MedTimingNavGraph
name: MedTimingNavGraph
description: Now that BottomNavTab.label is labelRes: Int, the two render-time usages (icon contentDescription, Text label) resolve it via stringResource(tab.labelRes) instead of using tab.label directly. Everything else in the function (nav wiring, routes) is unchanged.
acceptance_criteria: All navigation/route wiring is unchanged from before
